title: Cardiac Rhythm & Electrocardiographic Monitoring Protocol
plain_language_summary: Abnormal heart rate trends, rhythm irregularities, or ECG deviations from the crew member's established cardiovascular baseline have been detected.
crew_instructions: Verify ECG electrode placement and repeat a 12-lead ECG recording when available.
Repeat heart rate and blood pressure measurements to confirm the observed deviation.
Record symptoms including palpitations, chest discomfort, dizziness, breathlessness, or fainting.
Review recent cardiovascular telemetry and compare findings with the crew member's personal baseline.
Notify the crew medical officer and transmit ECG and vital-sign data for ground review.
de_escalation_criteria: Heart rate and ECG measurements return to established personal baseline, no concerning symptoms are reported, and repeat monitoring remains stable.
